**Overarching Observation:** Items CHK-PROP-W5B6-25 through CHK-PROP-W5B6-29 describe execution layer concepts (`decode_receipt`, typed receipt type-prefix validation, RLP depth limits, RLP canonicality) that have no implementation in OffchainLabs/prysm. 1. Never decodes raw RLP-encoded transaction receipts from any source
2. Stores only `receipts_root` (a 32-byte hash) in execution payload fields
3. Delegates receipt validity entirely to the execution client via the Engine API (newPayload response)
4. Uses go-ethereum v1.15.9 as a dependency for pre-decoded `types.Log` objects

```go
func (s *Service) ProcessLog(ctx context.Context, depositLog *gethtypes.Log) error {
    s.processingLock.RLock()       // READ LOCK acquired
    defer s.processingLock.RUnlock()
    // ...
    if index != s.lastReceivedMerkleIndex+1 { ... }
    s.lastReceivedMerkleIndex = index  // WRITE to shared state under READ LOCK
